Message:
feat: pipeline live data, A2A enforcement, competitive-intelligence — 2026-02-24

- Added '## Autonomous skill discovery (MANDATORY)' section
  Agents must proactively scan workspace/skills/ weekly, not wait to be told

  Telegrams Anurag + spawns RED if count = 0
- ci-weekly-research-0001: RESEARCH runs competitive intelligence every Monday 9am ET
  scans Cursor/v0/Perplexity/Devin/Windsurf, posts to #redos-mission-control

  a2a-delegations.jsonl before/after every sessions_spawn

openclaw.json:
- competitive-intelligence skill enabled (was missing from entries, defaulted to false)

New files:
- workspace/scripts/test_a2a.py: run anytime to check A2A health
- workspace/ops/CEO-DIRECTIVE-20260224.md: P1 directive — skill audit + A2A enforcement
- workspace/MEMORY.md: updated current state to 2026-02-24

Diagnosis:
- 37 subagent sessions happened today but a2a-delegations.jsonl was empty
- Root cause: a2a-transparency SKILL.md is reference doc, not enforced behavior
- Fix: SOUL.md now mandates logging on every spawn (takes effect next session)
